units.literal: Restrain appetites, practice diligence and frugality, pity widows and orphans, correct punishments, do not rashly pardon the guilty, do not wrongly kill the innocent—let fine customs spread below and sagely virtue be heard above—then even with flood or drought there will be no harm.

units.zh: 豈以濫舍有罪，而反能救其災乎？
units.en: How can rash pardon of the guilty save disaster?
units.literal: How can rashly pardoning the guilty in turn save the disaster?

units.zh: 彰其德乎？
units.en: Or display his virtue?
units.literal: Manifest his virtue?

units.zh: 是知赦之不可行也明哉！」
units.en: Thus it is clear amnesty must not be practiced!"
units.literal: Thus it is clear that amnesty must not be practiced!'

units.zh: 帝覽而嘉之，降詔獎飾，仍付史館。
units.en: The emperor read it with praise, issued a reward edict, and sent it to the Historiography.
units.literal: The emperor read it and praised it, issued an edict of reward, and sent it to the Historiography.

units.zh: 五年，遷禮部侍郎，凡三典貢部，改御史中丞，轉兵部侍郎、知制誥，充翰林學士承旨。
units.en: In year five he was vice minister of rites, thrice ran the examinations, became censor in chief, then vice minister of war, edict drafter, and chief Hanlin academician.
units.literal: In the fifth year he was promoted to vice minister of rites; he thrice presided over the tribute examinations, was made censor in chief, transferred to vice minister of war and drafter of edicts, and chief Hanlin academician.

units.zh: 契丹入京城，落職守本官。
units.en: When the Khitans took the capital he was demoted but kept his original rank.
units.literal: When the Khitan entered the capital he was demoted but kept his original office.

units.zh: 〈（《東都事略·劉溫叟傳》：契丹入京師，溫叟懼隨契丹北徙，與承旨張允求去職。
units.en: (Brief Account of the Eastern Capital, Biography of Liu Wensou: When the Khitans entered the capital, Wensou feared being taken north and with Chief Academician Zhang Yun sought to resign.
units.literal: (From the Biography of Liu Wensou in the Brief Account of the Eastern Capital: When the Khitan entered the capital, Wensou feared being taken north with them and with Chief Academician Zhang Yun sought to leave office.

units.zh: 契丹主怒，欲黜為縣令。
units.en: The Khitan ruler was angry and wished to demote him to county magistrate.
units.literal: The Khitan ruler was angry and wished to demote him to county magistrate.

units.zh: 趙延壽曰：「學士不稱職而求解者，罷之可也。」
units.en: Zhao Yanshou said, "When an academician is unfit and asks to leave, dismissal suffices."
units.literal: Zhao Yanshou said: "When an academician is unfit for office and seeks release, dismissal is enough."

units.zh: 得不黜。）〉
units.en: He was not demoted.)〉
units.literal: He was not demoted.)〉

units.zh: 乾祐初，授吏部侍郎。
units.en: Early in Qianyou he was vice minister of personnel.
units.literal: At the beginning of Qianyou he was appointed vice minister of personnel.

units.zh: 自誅史宏肇後，京城士庶，連甍恐悚，允每朝退，即宿於相國寺僧舍。
units.en: After Hongzhao's execution the capital lived in terror; after each court session Yun slept in a monk's cell at Xiangguo Temple.
units.literal: After Shi Hongzhao was executed, gentry and commoners in the capital were in continuous terror; after each court session Yun lodged in a monk's cell at Xiangguo Temple.

units.zh: 及北軍入京師，允匿於佛殿藻井之上，墜屋而卒，時年六十五。
units.en: When the northern army entered the capital he hid in the Buddha hall ceiling, fell through, and died at sixty-five.
units.literal: When the northern army entered the capital, Yun hid in the coffered ceiling of the Buddha hall, fell through the roof, and died at age sixty-five.

units.zh: 子鸞，仕皇朝為太常少卿。
units.en: His son Luan served the Song as vice director of imperial sacrifices.
units.literal: His son Luan served the Song court as vice director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.

units.zh: 任延皓，并州人也。
units.en: Ren Yanhao was from Bing Prefecture.
units.literal: Ren Yanhao was a native of Bing Prefecture.

units.zh: 業術數風雲之事。
units.en: He mastered numerology and divination by wind and cloud.
units.literal: He mastered numerology and the arts of wind and cloud omens.

units.zh: 晉高祖在太原重圍時，高祖最為親要，延皓以本業請見，高祖甚加禮遇。
units.en: When Jin Gaozu was besieged at Taiyuan, Yanhao was among his most trusted; he sought audience by his arts and was greatly honored.
units.literal: When the Jin Gaozu was in the heavy siege at Taiyuan he was among those most intimate and trusted; Yanhao asked audience by his profession and was greatly honored.

units.zh: 晉天福初，延皓授太原掾，尋改交城、文水令，皆高祖慰薦之力也。
units.en: Early in Tianfu he was Taiyuan clerk, then magistrate of Jiaocheng and Wenshui on Gaozu's recommendation.
units.literal: At the beginning of Jin Tianfu Yanhao was appointed Taiyuan clerk, soon changed to magistrate of Jiaocheng and Wenshui—all by the Gaozu's comforting recommendation.

units.zh: 高祖鎮太原，延皓多言外事，出入無間，高祖左右皆憚之。
units.en: When Gaozu governed Taiyuan, Yanhao spoke constantly of outside affairs and came and went freely; even his close attendants feared him.
units.literal: When the Gaozu governed Taiyuan, Yanhao spoke much of external affairs and came and went without interval; those at the Gaozu's side all feared him.

units.zh: 在文水聚斂財賄，民欲陳訴，延皓知之。
units.en: At Wenshui he extorted wealth; when the people meant to complain, he learned of it.
units.literal: At Wenshui he amassed wealth by extortion; the people wished to complain and Yanhao learned of it.

units.zh: 一日，先誣告縣吏結集百姓，欲劫縣庫。
units.en: One day he first accused the county clerks of rallying the people to loot the treasury.
units.literal: One day he first falsely reported that county clerks had gathered the people to plunder the county treasury.

units.zh: 高祖怒，遣騎軍並擒縣民十數，族誅之，冤枉之聲，聞於行路。
units.en: Gaozu sent cavalry who seized a dozen county people and executed their clans; cries of injustice filled the roads.
units.literal: The Gaozu was angry and sent cavalry who together seized more than ten county people and executed their clans; cries of injustice were heard on the roads.

units.zh: 高祖即位，累官至殿中監，恃寵使氣，人望而畏之，雖宰輔之重，延皓視之蔑如也。
units.en: When Gaozu took the throne Yanhao rose to palace director; arrogant with favor, he was feared at sight; even chancellors he treated with contempt.
units.literal: When the Gaozu took the throne, Yanhao rose to palace director; relying on favor he was overbearing and men feared him at sight; even chancellors he regarded with contempt.

units.zh: 劉崇在河東，日常切齒。
units.en: Liu Chong at Hedong gnashed his teeth at him daily.
units.literal: Liu Chong at Hedong daily gnashed his teeth at him.

units.zh: 及魏王承訓薨，歸葬太原，令延皓擇葬地，時有山岡僧謂劉崇曰：「魏王葬地不吉，恐有重喪。」
units.en: When Chengxun, Prince of Wei, died and was buried at Taiyuan, Yanhao chose the site; a hill monk told Liu Chong, "The burial ground is ill-omened; I fear further mourning."
units.literal: When Chengxun, Prince of Wei, died and was buried at Taiyuan, Yanhao was ordered to choose the burial ground; a hill monk then told Liu Chong: "The prince's burial ground is inauspicious; I fear repeated mourning."

units.zh: 未幾，高祖崩，崇以僧言奏之，乃配流延皓於麟州。
units.en: Soon Gaozu died; Chong reported the monk's words and Yanhao was banished to Lin Prefecture.
units.literal: Before long the Gaozu died; Chong memorialized the monk's words and Yanhao was banished to Lin Prefecture.

units.zh: 路由文水，市民擲瓦毆罵甚眾，吏人救之僅免。
units.en: Passing Wenshui, townspeople pelted him with tiles and cursed him; clerks barely saved him.
units.literal: Passing Wenshui, townspeople threw tiles and cursed him in great numbers; clerks barely saved him.

units.zh: 既至貶所，劉崇令人殺之，籍沒其家。
units.en: At his place of exile Chong had him killed and his property confiscated.
units.literal: Reaching his place of exile, Chong had him killed and his household confiscated.

units.zh: 史臣曰：李崧仕唐、晉之兩朝，聳伊、臯之重望，考其器業，無忝臺衡。
units.en: The historian writes: Li Song served Tang and Jin, bearing the weight of Yi and Gao; in capacity and achievement he did not disgrace the highest office.
units.literal: The historian says: Li Song served the two dynasties of Tang and Jin, towering with the heavy repute of Yi and Gao; examining his capacity and achievement, he did not disgrace the highest office.

units.zh: 會多僻之朝，被參夷之戮，人之不幸，天亦難忱。
units.en: In a crooked age he suffered execution that wiped out his clan—man's misfortune, and Heaven is hard to fathom.
units.literal: Meeting a perverse age, he suffered execution that extinguished his clan—man's misfortune, and Heaven too is hard to fathom.

units.zh: 逢吉秉蛇虺之心，竊夔、龍之位，殺人不忌，與國俱亡。
units.en: Fengji bore a viper's heart, usurped Kui and Long's place, killed without scruple, and perished with the state.
units.literal: Fengji bore a viper's heart and usurped the place of Kui and Long, killing without scruple and perishing with the state.

units.zh: 李崧之冤血未銷，逢吉之梟首斯至，冥報之事，安可忽諸！
units.en: Song's unjust blood was not dry when Fengji's head was displayed—hidden retribution must not be ignored!
units.literal: Li Song's unjust blood was not yet dry when Fengji's displayed head arrived—how can matters of hidden retribution be neglected!

units.zh: 自李鏻而下，凡數君子者，皆踐履朝行，彰施帝載，國華邦直，斯焉在哉！
units.en: From Li Lin down, these gentlemen walked the court ranks and shone in the imperial record—national grace and integrity dwell here!
units.literal: From Li Lin downward, these several gentlemen all trod the court ranks and shone in the imperial record—the state's flower and the state's integrity are here!

units.zh: 惟延皓之醜行，宜乎不得其死矣。
units.en: Only Yanhao's vile conduct—fitting that he died as he did.
units.literal: Only Yanhao's vile conduct—fitting that he should not die a natural death.
